notes.title: Welcome! - DevLog 1
notes.content:
Hello!

Thank you for reading this post. I'm happy to announce that I'm gonna write a development post each week to show you my current progress of the game.

This week I was working on Inventory UI (still work in progress). The whole goal of the inventory is to manage the upgrades of each weapon. You will be able to mix upgrades like bombs and fire to make fire explosives and set on fire multiple enemies at one shoot!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831565/6c8e7d49c63d4d53204de33d7cd578a513a0cae1.gif[/img]

I also made a short trailer to have something to show on steam store. Have fun watching!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1Zs1u-0ZA0I
